rune_surge.name: Rune Surge
rune_surge.description: Rune-light sharpens every ward and fills the trials with power. Enemies gain +1 AC; Rune Shards increase by 50%; all rewards increase by 10%.

smugglers_moon.name: Smugglers' Moon
smugglers_moon.description: The tunnels open and the Watch looks elsewhere. Black-market prices fall by 20% and all rewards increase by 10%.

watch_crackdown.name: Watch Crackdown
watch_crackdown.description: The Watch controls the market and pays well for order. Mirt's market discount improves by 10%, but all rewards increase by 10%.

long_winter.name: Long Winter
long_winter.description: The roads freeze and every fire costs more. Enemies gain 10% HP, rests cost 5 more gold, and all rewards increase by 20%.
